en.name: Scroll of Protection from Plants
entries: Using an action to read the scroll encloses you in an {@condition invisible} barrier that extends from you to form a 5-foot-radius, 10-foot-high cylinder. For 5 minutes, this barrier prevents plants from entering or affecting anything within the cylinder. The cylinder moves with you and remains centered on you. However, if you move in such a way that a plant would be inside the cylinder, the effect ends. A creature can attempt to overcome the barrier by using an action to make a {@dc 15} Charisma check. On a success, the creature ceases to be affected by the barrier.

en.name: Sending Stones
entries: Sending stones come in pairs, with each smooth stone carved to match the other so the pairing is easily recognized. While you touch one stone, you can use an action to cast the {@spell sending} spell from it. The target is the bearer of the other stone. If no creature bears the other stone, you know that fact as soon as you use the stone and don't cast the spell.
Once {@spell sending} is cast through the stones, they can't be used again until the next dawn. If one of the stones in a pair is destroyed, the other one becomes nonmagical.

texts.fr: Pierres de communication

Les pierres de communication vont par paire. Chaque pierre lisse est sculptée pour correspondre à l’autre et rendre la paire aisément reconnaissable. Tant que tu touches une pierre, tu peux consacrer une action à lancer le sort {@spell sending} par son intermédiaire. La cible est le porteur de l’autre pierre. Si aucune créature ne porte l’autre pierre, tu le sais dès que tu utilises la pierre et ne lances pas le sort.
Une fois {@spell sending} lancé par l’intermédiaire des pierres, elles ne peuvent plus être utilisées avant l’aube suivante. Si une pierre d’une paire est détruite, l’autre devient non magique.

entries: Dragon scale mail is made of the scales of one kind of dragon. Sometimes dragons collect their cast-off scales and gift them to humanoids. en.name: Spell Scroll (1st Level)
entries: A spell scroll bears the words of a single spell, written as a mystical cipher. If the spell is on your class's spell list, you can read the scroll and cast its spell without providing any material components. Otherwise, the scroll is unintelligible. Casting the spell by reading the scroll requires the spell's normal casting time. Once the spell is cast, the words on the scroll fade, and it crumbles to dust. If the casting is interrupted, the scroll is not lost.

If the spell is on your class's spell list but of a higher level than you can normally cast, you must make an ability check using your spellcasting ability to determine whether you cast it successfully. The DC is 11. On a failed check, the spell disappears from the scroll with no other effect.
Once the spell is cast, the words on the scroll fade, and the scroll itself crumbles to dust.
A spell cast from this scroll has a save DC of 13 and an attack bonus of {@hit 5}.

A wizard spell on a spell scroll can be copied just as spells in spellbooks can be copied. When a spell is copied from a spell scroll, the copier must succeed on a {@dc 11} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check. If the check succeeds, the spell is successfully copied. Whether the check succeeds or fails, the spell scroll is destroyed.

Lancer le sort en lisant le parchemin demande le temps d’incantation normal du sort. Une fois le sort lancé, les mots s’effacent et le parchemin se réduit en poussière. Si l’incantation est interrompue, le parchemin n’est pas perdu.

texts.fr: Un sort de magicien sur un parchemin de sort peut être recopié comme les sorts d’un grimoire. Pour recopier un sort depuis un parchemin, le copiste doit réussir un test d’Intelligence {@dc 19} ({@skill Arcana||Arcanes}). En cas de réussite, le sort est recopié. Que le test soit réussi ou raté, le parchemin de sort est détruit.

en.name: Spell Scroll (Cantrip)
entries: A spell scroll bears the words of a single spell, written as a mystical cipher. If the spell is on your class's spell list, you can read the scroll and cast its spell without providing any material components. Otherwise, the scroll is unintelligible. Casting the spell by reading the scroll requires the spell's normal casting time. Once the spell is cast, the words on the scroll fade, and it crumbles to dust. If the casting is interrupted, the scroll is not lost.

If the spell is on your class's spell list but of a higher level than you can normally cast, you must make an ability check using your spellcasting ability to determine whether you cast it successfully. The DC is 10. On a failed check, the spell disappears from the scroll with no other effect.
Once the spell is cast, the words on the scroll fade, and the scroll itself crumbles to dust.
A spell cast from this scroll has a save DC of 13 and an attack bonus of {@hit 5}.
